text: 'Complete, nothing capped' means max_catalogs must be JSON null. Omitting it would cap at the default, and the string "None" is not null.

Every matched VizieR radio catalogue for this field: 47 catalogs, 4127 rows, uncapped, written in full to {{artifact:0}}. I passed max_catalogs as JSON null rather than omitting it, since an omitted value caps at the default rather than lifting the cap.
